contract.structural_score_basis: USDe's Ethereum token is immutable: its implementation, admin and beacon slots are zero and verified code exposes no upgrade path. Full-reach ownership and EthenaMintingV2 administration pass through a 24-hour timelock. The same 5-of-10 Dev Safe is proposer and sole canceller, so holders receive notice but there is no independent veto. Immediate operational and whitelisted-execution powers are bounded by supported assets, signed orders, tolerances and caps. Newly enumerated cross-chain deployments remain outside this canonical Ethereum score until walked.
contract.coverage_summary: Canonical Ethereum token and minting authority refreshed at block 26,159,080.
contract.coverage_note: Cross-chain transport and peer authority are not inferred from Ethereum and are not averaged into this canonical score.
code_facts: USDe has no proxy upgrade path on Ethereum.
The full-reach authority path has a code-enforced 24-hour delay.
The 5-of-10 Dev Safe holds proposer and canceller roles, so cancellation is not independent.
Immediate operational paths are bounded rather than full-reach.
